name: XAG P150 Max
description: State-of-the-art agricultural drone designed for superior efficiency in field spraying, spreading, and mapping operations. Delivers spraying productivity of roughly 50-60 acres per hour with a maximum payload of 176 lbs (80 kg) and flight speed up to 44.7 mph.
specs: Field mapping coverage: up to 20 hectares per flight
Max spray flow rate: 46 L/min (four-nozzle configuration)
Battery: B141050 Smart SuperCharge, 1050 Wh, up to 1500 cycles
Rapid charge time: 7 minutes with parallel chargers
Obstacle detection range: 1.5-100 m via 4D imaging radar
Video transmission range: up to 2 km

name: XAG P100 Pro
tagline: Pro in every flight - Flexibly efficient
description: Plant protection UAS with a folded footprint roughly 62% smaller than its predecessor. Combines the RevoSpray 3 spraying system and RevoCast 3 spreading system with the RealTerra 2 mapping module, 4D imaging radar obstacle avoidance, and swarm control of up to two drones simultaneously.
specs: Container capacity: 80 L standard tank / 50 L smart tank
RevoSpray 3: max flow rate 22 L/min, droplet size 60-400 microns, spray width 5-10 m, 50 L tank, up to 19 ha/h open field / 2 ha/h orchard
RevoCast 3: max spread rate 150 kg/min, max flight speed 13.8 m/s, spread width 3-7 m, granule size 1-6 mm, 1,300 kg/h fertilizing / 30 ha/h feeding
Battery: B13960s Smart SuperCharge, 962 Wh, 4.2 kg
Charging time: 11 minutes via CM13600 (3,400 W) charger
Obstacle avoidance flight speed: up to 13.8 m/s
RealTerra 2 mapping: 13 hectares surveyed per flight, offline map generation, 3D route planning
Control options: XAG One app (iOS/Android), ARC3 Pro remote controller, ACS2 handheld control stick, virtual RTK positioning, 2-drone swarm control

name: XAG P150
description: Positioned as the ultimate agricultural drone designed for spraying, spreading, and field mapping. Features a modular, collapsible design that reduces stowed volume by 20%, the SuperX 5 Pro intelligent control system with 4D imaging radar, and real-time 3D terrain mapping for autonomous flight.
specs: SuperX 5 Pro intelligent control system with 4D imaging radar
Real-time 3D terrain mapping for autonomous flight
Battery: B13970S Smart SuperCharge, 975 Wh, up to 1500 cycles

name: XAG P60
tagline: Small But Mighty - One Person, One Drone, That's All
description: Compact, flexible, and cost-effective drone for spraying, spreading, and field mapping, designed for autonomous single-operator farm operations.
specs: Survey capacity: up to 13.3 hectares per flight
RevoCast 4 spreading system with variable-rate application
RealTerra 3 mapping with real-time 3D terrain mapping
SuperX 5 Pro intelligent control system with 4D imaging radar
IPX6K water protection, collapsible design (20% volume reduction)
Control options: XAG One app, ACS4 control stick, SRC4 remote

name: XAG R100
tagline: Your trusted partner for plant protection in orchards and greenhouses
description: Ground-based agricultural rover providing precise, uniform spraying with simple remote control, built for orchard and greenhouse plant protection.
specs: RevoSpray system with dual centrifugal atomizers, 60-200 micron droplets
Tank capacity: 120 L, max flow rate 8 L/min
Max horizontal spray range: 7 m per side
Compact width: 80 cm; curb weight: 80 kg
Ground clearance: 270 mm with suspended portal axle
Autonomous navigation with path tracking and repeat mode
Battery: XAG Smart SuperCharge, 1050 Wh, ~30 minutes runtime

name: XAG R200
tagline: Reliable, targeted spraying for orchards and greenhouses
description: Six-wheel ground rover delivering reliable, targeted spraying for orchards and greenhouses with six-wheel stability and intuitive remote control.
specs: Precision spraying system with four pumps and centrifugal atomizers
Tank capacity: 240 L, max flow rate 16 L/min
Compact width: 80 cm; curb weight: 130 kg
SuperX 5 Ultra intelligent control system for autonomous operation
XAG SRC 5 remote controller with 7-inch touchscreen
Path tracking, cruise mode, variable-rate spraying

name: XAG APC2 AutoPilot Console
description: All-in-one automated steering solution for hands-free operation, enabling tractors, harvesters, rice transplanters, and sprayers to operate with centimeter-level accuracy across paddy fields, dry fields, and mountain terrain. Available in three variants: Standard APC2, APC2 Slim, and APC2 Flex.
specs: Positioning accuracy: +/-2.5 cm using RTK/PPP technology
Three model variants: Standard, Slim, and Flex
Smartphone app control with automatic route planning
Terrain compensation via IMU inertial sensors
Multiple guidance line modes: AB Straight, AB Curve, Drill Seeding, etc.
Compatible with tractors, harvesters, rice transplanters, and sprayers

name: XAG FBV Smart Electric Valve
description: Smart valve system enabling full automation and optimized water distribution via smartphone control, part of XAG's Smart Farm IoT lineup. Available in straight-through (FBV2), three-way (FBV3), and five-way (FBV5) configurations.
specs: Three valve models: FBV2 (straight-through), FBV3 (three-way), FBV5 (five-way)
Real-time water pressure detection via built-in sensors
Smartphone control via XAG Farm App (iOS/Android)
Remote ON/OFF for valves and pumps
Automatic pressure balancing for water/nutrient delivery
Power options: built-in lithium battery, solar, portable battery backup, AC grid
Connectivity: Bluetooth/Wi-Fi, integrates with XAG FS2 local server
